mapper.sql: ro.id, ro.user_id, ro.recipe_id, ro.order_time, ro.status, ro.complete_time, ro.remark, ro.people_count, ro.create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT , u.name as user_name, r.name as recipe_name, r.image_url as recipe_image_url FROM recipe_order ro LEFT JOIN user u ON ro.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN recipe r ON ro.recipe_id = r.id WHERE 1=1
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{recipeName}, '%')
AND ro.status = #{status}
ORDER BY ro.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe_order SET status = #{status}, complete_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
